SRP251372 Sequence Review
Gene track · PD-L1 high vs low model (vdd984)

Selected sequences of the PD-L1 high vs low model, each drawn on its gene and marked by how it matches the genome and how other isoforms read it

Drawn: the selected sequences that have a genome position on a primary chromosome. Listed in the table under the track: every row of the model on that gene, selected or not. The gene list counts genes with at least one placed row. This model was added to the track for the Highlights page with the same placement and gene rules as the other models on this page; its sequences were not BLASTed.

Choose a model, then a gene. Genes are listed by the total weight of their selected sequences. Click a lollipop, a mark below the line, or a table row to open the sequence's card: its bases with any differences coloured in place, alignment, mismatch, known SNP, ClinVar, weight, isoform readings and BLAST result.
